description: Blocks a `git commit` that stages USER-VISIBLE files (.tsx/.jsx/.vue/.svelte/.css/.scss/.html/.svg/images, or under components|ui|pages|app|views|public|assets/) unless a fresh, repo-scoped proof marker exists in ~/.cache/agent-tools/visual-proof/ (within VISUAL_PROOF_WINDOW_S, 3600s): a `dev shot` attestation bound to this repo AND this staged diff AND a re-hashed capture file with a clean worktree at capture time, or a `--write-marker`-written fallback bound to this repo. No user-visible files staged => allow. The `git diff --cached` lister is timeout-bounded and fails OPEN. No self-service bypass: request a one-time Telegram approval via RIG_HATCH_REQUEST_VISUAL_PROOF_GATE='<justification>' (deny-by-default; bare 1 rejected) — allows only on the human's tg-ctl approval, which is why timeout_ms is 960000 (tg-ctl's live-Telegram cap). on_error=open.
